en-US.description:
4TEEN is a self-custody TRON wallet for creating, importing, and managing wallets while keeping signing control on your device.

Use 4TEEN to:

• Create and import multiple TRON wallets
• Keep signing and watch-only wallets together
• View TRX and supported TRC-20 token balances
• Send and receive supported assets
• Review wallet activity and token details
• Manage visible and custom tokens
• Save frequently used addresses
• Scan and display QR codes
• Open websites in a generic in-app browser
• Protect access with a local passcode and biometrics
• View read-only protocol, token unlock, received distribution, and existing ambassador records

The protocol sections are for viewing records only. Transaction and participation functions in these sections are unavailable on iOS.

Private keys and recovery phrases remain under the user’s control. 4TEEN does not take custody of assets or sign transactions without the user’s explicit approval.

Cryptocurrency activity involves risk. Token values, network availability, and transaction fees can change.
en-US.promoText: Create, import, and manage self-custody TRON wallets with secure local signing.

review.notes:
4TEEN is a self-custody TRON wallet. No server account or login is required. On a fresh install, create a local passcode of your choice if prompted. There is no preset review passcode.

Version 1.0.6 restores navigation and adds read-only records, not transaction capabilities:
- HOME > UNLOCK: 4TEEN balances and recorded token unlock history.
- HOME > LIQUIDITY: public contract balance and address only.
- HOME > INFO: public protocol contract addresses.
- EARN > AMBASSADOR: existing accrual totals and purchase/reward records only. No registration, referral promotion/sharing, withdrawal, replay, or participation controls.
- EARN > AIRDROP: received on-chain distribution records only. No claim button, social tasks, subscriptions, referral rewards, or new token earning flow.

This iOS build does not provide cryptocurrency exchange services. Swap and Buy icons remain visible in the navigation for layout consistency, but tapping them only shows an unavailability notice. Native Swap, Direct Buy, token purchase or token issuance, liquidity execution, and related transaction routes remain unavailable on iOS for every user and region. No remote switch activates these features after review.

The generic browser does not inject a wallet provider, expose private keys, or sign website transactions. It is a standard WebView for user-entered URLs. Unrestricted Web Access is declared in the age rating.

To review without funds: Import Wallet > Import by Watch-Only Address, then enter this public address:
TN95o1fsA7mNwJGYGedvf3y7DJZKLH6TCT
A watch-only wallet supports balances, transaction history, and the new read-only sections without signing or a private key. The new sections display retrieved records and loading/error states; no sample rewards are generated.

AG PLUS, MCHJ does not take custody of user assets. Existing send/receive wallet functionality is unchanged.
